definition-changed.answer: §2002:4 (4.166) 'One or more runtime modules that interact with one another and that function, at execution time, as an entity'; §2023:3.158 rewords it ('runtime entity ... independent entity'). The same entity; 'not been called in this run unit' covers the same programs.

pending-clause.answer: Read §2002:14.5.2.1.2.1 (initial state), 14.5.3 (transfers of control) and 14.5.10 (normal run unit termination); 2002 14.5.3 says 'paragraph' where 2023 says 'procedure', 2002 14.5.10 has the MCS purge item and lacks COMMIT and dynamic-table items, 2002 initial state also initializes the communication section. The initial state after CANCEL (§2002:14.5.2.1.2.1 item 3) is CANCEL GR3's; GR7 is the no-action case and its transfer to the next statement is ordinary 14.5.3 flow. No dependence on the differing text; the reader's cancel_q25.cob at 2002 stands.
